divergences.spec: role_channels が縛るのは、それが挙げる role だけである（role_channels に無い role は channel_group だけで決まり、channel_group に無い role は role_channels だけで決まる）。 (core §7.4, read through debug §1 "**ピンの組**: describe の channel_group / role_channels が候補を宣言する。")
divergences.fix: usable pairs computed per group (a listed role is the group's channel, in role_channels when they list it; an unlisted role from role_channels; no groups: role_channels alone) instead of requiring one group or role_channels to list both roles

divergences.spec: channel_group に無い role は role_channels だけで決まる (core §7.4; debug §1 ピンの組)
divergences.fix: _group_pair (a missing SWCLK taken as 0xFFFF, crash on _role_pairs when role 1 came only from a group) replaced by _group_pairs, the same pairs _allows accepts; the role_channels target only for wires without groups

divergences.spec: channel_group に無い role は role_channels だけで決まる (core §7.4; debug §1 ピンの組)
divergences.fix: with channel_groups the rvswd pairs are the declared ones (candidate_pairs) within the safe pool, not role_channels' role 1 x role 2 filtered by them

divergences.spec: 線からの応答無しで失敗したやり取り（上の線切れに数える失敗）から、その線でやり取りが成功するまで、または connection を失うまで、probe はやり取りの間、その線を放した状態で休ませ、やり取りの最中だけ駆動する (failures counted "要求の中でもコンソールの読みの中でも", debug §2 線切れ)
divergences.fix: each poll sets the connection's free state from whether its target answers (unanswered: lines released; answered: rest state back)

divergences.spec: **attach の flags**（3 線共通、registry の `attach_flags`）: bit0 保留中の havereset を確認応答した（riscv） / attach は保留中の havereset を先に確認応答する (§4.6)
divergences.fix: the reset through the line leaves havereset pending (as the riscv-dm reset op does), so the attach acknowledges it and sets bit0

divergences.spec: probe は 1 つの要求の中で線を再試行してよい（どれだけ続けるかは probe が決め、遅い速さでの再試行を含む）。
divergences.fix: dropped rows[1].speed < rows[0].speed (a slower retry is allowed, not required); the first try at speed_hz and speed_hz unchanged are still checked
